items.author: KeithSmithNBA
items.body_excerpt:
Good for Saddiq Bey. He earned this deal after playing well when he returned from a torn ACL.

Feels a bit high at an AAV of $18.3M, but not egregiously so. Still not sure I see the long-term vision in New Orleans though. I like all the players. I don’t like the way they fit.
